fix(config): CI required-check never reports on backlog/docs-only PRs. ci.yml uses workflow-level paths-ignore (.backlogit, docs, .autoharness, *.md) on the pull_request trigger, so the whole CI workflow (including the 'Detect code changes' job that IS ruleset PR-Required's required status check) is skipped for backlog/docs-only PRs. The required check stays 'expected' forever, permanently BLOCKING such PRs and forcing admin bypass (which fails when bypass_actors is empty). Fix: remove paths-ignore from the pull_request trigger so the 'changes' job always runs and reports 'Detect code changes'; the 'Build, vet, lint & test' job already self-gates via 'if: needs.changes.outputs.code==true' plus the dorny/paths-filter denylist, so it stays skipped for backlog-only diffs. Consider same for push. Removes recurring admin-merge need on staging/closure PRs.

fix(transcript): escape participant-controlled fields in the Markdown transcript writer. Session forwards Teams-controlled speaker/text unchanged and transcript.Writer.WriteEvent interpolates both directly into Markdown, so a crafted display name or caption can inject Markdown/HTML (headings, links) into the rendered transcript. Escape/neutralize speaker and text (and consider caption text) in WriteEvent (or in the capture sink) with regression tests. Low severity (local file, participant-controlled). Surfaced by PR #19 Copilot review.

BUG (internal/cli/root.go & internal/browser/meeting_chrome.go & internal/capture/session.go): Setting --mode past-recap (or capture_mode: past-recap in config.yaml) sets ForceRecap: true on MeetingOptions, which causes tryExtractRecapViaCDP and joinHeadedWithDeadline to short-circuit Join() as soon as captureAISummaryFromTargets finds the AI Summary on the outer page — BEFORE the SharePoint xplatplugins.aspx transcript iframe (.ms-List) has finished loading. Join() returns nil with len(m.recapEntries) == 0, so m.IsRecap() returns false, and Session.Run writes an empty transcript header (Total Attendees: 0, fallback meeting-ID title, zero utterances) and enters the live-call EnableCaptions loop where it hangs waiting for #callingButtons-showMoreBtn. Fix: separate AI-summary-only enrichment (runAppendAISummary) from full past-recap capture so past-recap waits for .ms-List transcript extraction before returning from Join().

BUG (internal/browser/recap.go & internal/capture/session.go): Running Meeting Recap capture with --recap-audio / --audio against a real SharePoint Stream recording fails with 'Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Failed to fetch' in extractRecapAudioJS (which calls fetch(mediaUrl, {credentials: 'include', redirect: 'error'}) against SharePoint media/blob URLs that redirect or use MSE, and enforces a 30-minute maxRecapAudioDurationSec = 1800 cap that rejects 1-hour meetings), leaves an empty 0-byte .mp3 file on disk, and aborts Session.Run before '# AI Summary' is appended to the .md transcript.

BUG (internal/cli/capture.go & internal/capture/session.go & internal/browser/meeting_chrome.go): Passing --no-ai-summary (or ai_summary_delay: 0s) is ignored when capturing a Meeting Recap: tryExtractRecapViaCDP / joinHeadedWithDeadline and Session.Run unconditionally extract and append '# AI Summary' to the output Markdown file even when --no-ai-summary is set.
